text: Psst. Yes, you. It's Friday... and you have no plans?
In a world... where the good seats vanish in minutes...
Your friends want the movie. Or the comedy show. Or the match!
So pick one. Together. Right here.
Middle row. Dead centre. Chef's kiss.
One tap, paid. And I didn't even spill.
Samosas? Pre-ordered. Popcorn too. Wait... is that... me?
No paper. No queue. Just walk in like a star.
